## Learning objectives

By the end of this chapter, you should be able to:

1. Explain the debate between rules-based and discretionary monetary policy
2. Describe the main tools available to central banks
3. Distinguish between corridor and floor systems for implementing policy
4. Explain what bank runs are and why they happen
5. Understand the lender of last resort function and its role in financial stability
